query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as total_dias,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) as total_realizado_com_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) / COUNT(*), 2) as media_diaria_com_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) + (SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) / COUNT(*) * 3), 2) as projecao_final_com_cat9
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
